name: linear_list_issues
description: List issues in the Linear workspace, most recently updated first: { id, identifier (e.g. 'ENG-123'), title, state{name}, assignee{name}, url, updatedAt }. Optional `first` caps how many to return (default ~50). The `id` is the UUID used by linear_update_issue and linear_create_comment; the `identifier` is the human key.

first.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

body_defaults.query: query ListIssues($first: Int) { issues(first: $first, orderBy: updatedAt) { nodes { id identifier title state { name } assignee { name } url updatedAt } } }
